properties.name: tcp.base.start-bot-token
properties.description: Initial bot token.

properties.name: tcp.base.bot-lord-token
properties.description: Bot lord token.

properties.name: tcp.base.director-id
properties.description: Director id. Director has total authority over the application (cross-bot authority).

properties.name: tcp.localizations.path
properties.description: Path to localization directories.

properties.name: tcp.localizations.format
properties.description: Localization files format (for example .txt).

properties.name: tcp.localizations.language-priority
properties.description: Language codes priority (from the most inportant to the least important, example: en, ru). These languages will only be used if there is no localization for the user's prefered language. This is an application wide setting and is used only if bot specific language priority is not available for any reason.

properties.name: tcp.scheduling.auto-clearing.delay
properties.description: Number of milliseconds in between calls to the removeExpired() method for all beans implementing the AutoClearable interface.

properties.name: tcp.scheduling.timed-trigger.delay
properties.description: Number of milliseconds in between checks for expired timed triggers.

properties.name: tcp.scheduling.session.expiration
properties.description: Number of seconds after which a user response session will expire.

properties.name: tcp.scheduling.multipage-meta.expiration
properties.description: Number of seconds after which a multipage meta will expire.

properties.name: tcp.scheduling.review-session.expiration
properties.description: Number of seconds after which a review session will expire.

properties.name: tcp.scheduling.feedback-session.expiration
properties.description: Number of seconds after which a feedback session will expire.

properties.name: tcp.paged-request.reviews.page-size
properties.description: How many new reviews will be shown per request.

properties.name: tcp.paged-request.homework.page-size
properties.description: How many new pending homeworks will be shown per request.

properties.name: tcp.webhook.secret
properties.description: Secret key to ensure webhook requests are comming from Telegram. A 256-bit randomly generated string should be more than sufficient.

properties.name: tcp.webhook.url
properties.description: The address on which the current Spring app is running.

properties.name: tcp.webhook.ip
properties.description: Required only if there is no DNS. Do not specify if you are running the server using HTTPS.

properties.name: tcp.webhook.max-connections
properties.description: The allowed number of simultaneous connections.

properties.name: tcp.webhook.use-certificate
properties.description: Whether to use the custom certificate. Should be false if you are running the server using HTTPS.

properties.name: tcp.invoice.images.path
properties.description: Directory in which images for invoices will be stored.

properties.name: tcp.exception.inform-director
properties.description: Whether to send a message with an attatched log file to the Director when an unspecified exception occurs. Use with caution.
